title: This whole session was played through the mcp__tinyforge__(new_game/act/look/status) tool interface rather than the `npm run turn` CLI. loop/report-check.mjs looks for a matching trace file under runs/ to replay and verify the final receipt; none existed for this session's seed, so the checker filed the report with verified:false even though the run completed a real *** WIN *** with a well-formed receipt. The MCP-tool entry point and the CLI entry point appear not to share the same trace/runs storage (or the MCP server runs from a different working directory), which undermines the receipt-verification pipeline for anyone playing via the tool interface.
where: loop/report-check.mjs replay step, after playing via mcp__tinyforge__act/new_game rather than `npm run -s turn`
